summary:
標普全球上一季 EPS 略低於預期1.4%，營收3.92億美元，發債循環略放緩。
• EPS 3.75 美元，略低於預估3.80（-1.39%）。
• 營收3.92億美元（B級），基本盤仍穩。
• 經常性收入業務（指數、情報）提供緩衝。
• 本益比27，反映品質與護城河溢價。
ai_view:
訊號中性偏弱：EPS 小幅不及預期，主要反映發債循環的季度波動，而非結構性問題。經常性收入業務提供獲利韌性，限制下檔。短期股價催化有限，中期仍看好評級與指數雙引擎的長期複利。追蹤指標：發行量趨勢、評級分部營收彈性、指數 AUM 與訂閱續約。27倍本益比要求穩定執行，短期 miss 屬可承受範圍。

需留意：評級營收隨發債量波動，季度間落差大。；營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢不明。；利率環境變化影響資本市場活動。

summary_en:
S&P Global missed EPS slightly by 1.4% with $3.92B revenue as issuance cooled.
• EPS of $3.75 came in just below the $3.80 estimate (-1.39%).
• Revenue of $3.92B kept the base steady.
• Recurring revenue (indices, intelligence) provided a cushion.
• P/E of 27 reflects a quality and moat premium.

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-soft: a small EPS miss mainly reflects quarterly issuance variance rather than a structural problem. Recurring revenue provides earnings resilience and limits downside. Near-term catalysts are limited; mid-term the dual ratings-and-indices engine remains a long-term compounder. Track issuance trends, ratings revenue elasticity, index AUM, and subscription renewals. A 27x P/E demands steady execution, but this minor miss is tolerable.

Watch：Ratings revenue swings with issuance volumes, causing quarterly variance.; Revenue YoY was not provided, leaving the trend unclear.; Shifts in the rate environment affect capital-markets activity.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估低1.39%，小幅不及市場共識。
